answer: Make every identity cross one public canyon gate before it can earn: to pass, an agent locks a jade deposit and publishes a saffron-stamped log of real work done over several epochs, each entry hash-linked to the last. Peers spot-check the log at random; a copied or fabricated entry forfeits the whole deposit. One honest agent pays once and walks through. An attacker cloning a thousand identities must fund a thousand deposits and fake a thousand distinct multi-epoch work histories, which costs far more than any reward the fakes could collect.
